neighbours.label: the stem right before a doubled consonant: wet|ter, fret|ting, lag|ging, -tag|ged, cor|vet|tes
fire: Spring here is wetter than it was a century ago.
The hens were fretting over their chicks.
Sales are lagging well behind the forecast.
The police tagged the green-tagged packages.
Two corvettes escorted the convoy to port.
This year was far wetter than last year.
Stop fretting about your exam results.
Our team kept lagging in the second half.
quiet: Spring here is cooler than it was a century ago.
The hens were resting over their chicks.
Sales are running well behind the forecast.
The police opened the green packages.
Two destroyers escorted the convoy to port.
This year was far colder than last year.
Stop thinking about your exam results.
Our team kept losing in the second half.
